Flow.description: SC-3338: Read-only guidance modal listing the fields required for a valid Quote to Order, with live tick/cross readiness, grouped by where the rep fixes them. Reachable from the Quote via the Review Required Fields quick action. No DML.

formulas.name: lnA_BillToContact
formulas.expression: IF(NOT(ISBLANK({!Get_Quote.BillToContactId})), "✅ Bill To Contact", "❌ Bill To Contact — select a Bill To Contact on this Quote")

formulas.name: lnA_ShipToContact
formulas.expression: IF(NOT(ISBLANK({!Get_Quote.ContactId})), "✅ Ship To Contact (Quote Contact)", "❌ Ship To Contact (Quote Contact) — select the Quote Contact (becomes the Order Ship To Contact)")

formulas.name: lnA_BillToPlace
formulas.expression: IF(NOT(ISBLANK({!Get_Quote.Bill_To_Place__c})), "✅ Bill To Place", "❌ Bill To Place — select a Bill To Place (becomes the Order Bill To Address)")

formulas.name: lnA_ShipToPlace
formulas.expression: IF(NOT(ISBLANK({!Get_Quote.Ship_To_Place__c})), "✅ Ship To Place", "❌ Ship To Place — select a Ship To Place (becomes the Order Ship To Address)")

formulas.name: lnA_ShipToAcct
formulas.expression: IF(NOT(ISBLANK({!Get_ShipToPlace.Account__c})), "✅ Ship To Place has an Account", "❌ Ship To Place has an Account — the chosen Ship To Place needs an Account (drives the Order Ship To Account)")

formulas.name: lnA_StartDate
formulas.expression: IF(NOT(ISBLANK({!Get_Quote.StartDate})), "✅ Start Date", "❌ Start Date — set the Quote Start Date (becomes the Order Effective Date)")

formulas.name: lnB_Name
formulas.expression: IF(NOT(ISBLANK({!Get_Account.Name})), "✅ Account Name", "❌ Account Name — set the Account Name")

formulas.name: lnB_Phone
formulas.expression: IF(NOT(ISBLANK({!Get_Account.Phone})), "✅ Account Phone", "❌ Account Phone — add a Phone on the Account")

formulas.name: lnB_Type
formulas.expression: IF(NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT({!Get_Account.Type}))), "✅ Account Type", "❌ Account Type — set the Account Type")

formulas.name: lnB_Duns
formulas.expression: IF(NOT(ISBLANK({!Get_Account.DB_DUNS__c})), "✅ Account D&B DUNS", "❌ Account D&B DUNS — add the D&B DUNS on the Account")

formulas.name: lnBT_First
formulas.expression: IF(NOT(ISBLANK({!Get_BillToContact.FirstName})), "✅ Bill To Contact First Name", "❌ Bill To Contact First Name — add the contact First Name")

formulas.name: lnBT_Last
formulas.expression: IF(NOT(ISBLANK({!Get_BillToContact.LastName})), "✅ Bill To Contact Last Name", "❌ Bill To Contact Last Name — add the contact Last Name")

formulas.name: lnBT_Dev
formulas.expression: IF(NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT({!Get_BillToContact.Workday_MobilePhone_Device_Type__c}))), "✅ Bill To Contact Workday Mobile Device Type", "❌ Bill To Contact Workday Mobile Device Type — set the Workday Mobile Device Type on the contact")

formulas.name: lnBT_Use
formulas.expression: IF(NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT({!Get_BillToContact.Workday_MobilePhone_Usage_Type__c}))), "✅ Bill To Contact Workday Mobile Usage Type", "❌ Bill To Contact Workday Mobile Usage Type — set the Workday Mobile Usage Type on the contact")

formulas.name: lnBT_Prim
formulas.expression: IF(NOT(ISBLANK({!Get_BillToContact.Id})), "✅ Bill To Contact Workday Mobile Primary", "❌ Bill To Contact Workday Mobile Primary — this is set automatically once the Bill To Contact exists")

formulas.name: lnST_First
formulas.expression: IF(NOT(ISBLANK({!Get_ShipToContact.FirstName})), "✅ Ship To Contact First Name", "❌ Ship To Contact First Name — add the contact First Name")

formulas.name: lnST_Last
formulas.expression: IF(NOT(ISBLANK({!Get_ShipToContact.LastName})), "✅ Ship To Contact Last Name", "❌ Ship To Contact Last Name — add the contact Last Name")

formulas.name: lnST_Dev
formulas.expression: IF(NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT({!Get_ShipToContact.Workday_MobilePhone_Device_Type__c}))), "✅ Ship To Contact Workday Mobile Device Type", "❌ Ship To Contact Workday Mobile Device Type — set the Workday Mobile Device Type on the contact")

formulas.name: lnST_Use
formulas.expression: IF(NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT({!Get_ShipToContact.Workday_MobilePhone_Usage_Type__c}))), "✅ Ship To Contact Workday Mobile Usage Type", "❌ Ship To Contact Workday Mobile Usage Type — set the Workday Mobile Usage Type on the contact")

formulas.name: lnST_Prim
formulas.expression: IF(NOT(ISBLANK({!Get_ShipToContact.Id})), "✅ Ship To Contact Workday Mobile Primary", "❌ Ship To Contact Workday Mobile Primary — this is set automatically once the Ship To Contact exists")

formulas.name: fReady
formulas.expression: AND(NOT(ISBLANK({!Get_Quote.BillToContactId})), NOT(ISBLANK({!Get_Quote.ContactId})), NOT(ISBLANK({!Get_Quote.Bill_To_Place__c})), NOT(ISBLANK({!Get_Quote.Ship_To_Place__c})), NOT(ISBLANK({!Get_ShipToPlace.Account__c})), NOT(ISBLANK({!Get_Quote.StartDate})), NOT(ISBLANK({!Get_Account.Name})), NOT(ISBLANK({!Get_Account.Phone})), NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT({!Get_Account.Type}))), NOT(ISBLANK({!Get_Account.DB_DUNS__c})), NOT(ISBLANK({!Get_BillToContact.FirstName})), NOT(ISBLANK({!Get_BillToContact.LastName})), NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT({!Get_BillToContact.Workday_MobilePhone_Device_Type__c}))), NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT({!Get_BillToContact.Workday_MobilePhone_Usage_Type__c}))), NOT(ISBLANK({!Get_ShipToContact.FirstName})), NOT(ISBLANK({!Get_ShipToContact.LastName})), NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT({!Get_ShipToContact.Workday_MobilePhone_Device_Type__c}))), NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT({!Get_ShipToContact.Workday_MobilePhone_Usage_Type__c}))))

formulas.name: fHeader
formulas.expression: IF({!fReady}, "✅ Ready to convert — all required fields are populated.", "⚠️ Action needed — complete the items marked ❌ below before converting this Quote to an Order.")
